profile.headline: Associate Software Developer at Pearson
profile.summary: I am a software developer based in Austin, Texas with strong skills in JavaScript, React.js, and Python. After several years as computer/electrical engineer, I expanded my skill set to include the latest web development technologies. I am passionate about learning the latest technologies and contributing quality code to solve challenging problems.

positions.title: System Applications Engineer
positions.description:
- Provided technical customer support for audio applications ranging from speech recognition to full-duplex voice communication.
- Directly supported field applications engineers and internal R&D teams for debugging and integration of embedded voice processors.
- Designed reference and demonstration voice controlled smart speakers and TV media streamers using a Raspberry Pi.
- Built demonstration software to showcase audio DSP features, and created demos in Python with Amazon’s Alexa Skills on AWS Lambda.
- Wrote testing scripts in TCL to verify functionality of audio DSP evaluation hardware.
- Performed and helped define new processes for audio tuning and testing.

positions.title: Software Engineer I
positions.description:
- Built test and calibration software to run on automated test equipment (ATE) for RF products in defense and space applications.
- Used C# and Windows Forms to create modular and scalable ATE software for easy integration of custom hardware requirements.
- Verified measurement performance and functionality of test instruments.
- Supported customers with onsite integration and training.
- Wrote software user’s manual and measurement reference manual for ATEs.

projects.title: Coding Jobs
projects.description: A job search tool focused on coding jobs and skills. This is a collaborative project built with React.js, Mongoose, and MDBootstrap.

projects.title: Fill-In-The-Code
projects.description: A quiz style coding learning tool where users must choose which blocks of code goes in the correct locations. This is a collaborative project built with Express, Sequelize, jQuery, and Handlebars.js.
